# vaults.cash

> One-call Uniswap v4 liquidity positions on Base (8453) and Robinhood
> Chain (4663). Convert the chain's stablecoin into slippage-bounded LP
> position call-batches. Fee 0.60% of converted amounts, embedded in the
> returned calls; minimum $5. Self-custodial: the executing wallet owns the
> position NFT; vaults.cash never holds funds or keys.

## MCP server (recommended for agents)

Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://vaults.cash/api/mcp/mcp
Tools: list_markets, get_balances, get_deposit_quote, build_deposit_calls,
build_add_calls, list_positions, build_withdraw_calls, build_collect_calls.
Build tools return {to, value, data} call batches you sign with your own wallet.
Optional `ref` on build tools: a vaults.cash referral code; half the fee is
paid on-chain to that code's wallet in the same batch (integrators: use yours).

## REST API (no auth, JSON)

- GET  /api/agent/markets — listed markets, live prices, pool ids, docs
- GET  /api/agent/quote?market=ETH&amountUsd=100&preset=balanced — read-only deposit split
- POST /api/agent/zap-plan {market, amountUsd, owner, preset?, widthPct?, slippageBps?, ref?, tokenId?} — executable calls: stablecoin -> LP position (tokenId = add to that existing position)
- GET  /api/agent/positions?owner=0x… — live positions for a wallet
- POST /api/agent/withdraw-plan {owner, tokenId, slippageBps?, ref?} — executable calls: position -> stablecoin

Presets: full (never rebalance) | balanced (±30%) | aggressive (±15%).
Execute calls IN ORDER from `owner`; batch atomically if the wallet supports it
(ERC-4337/EIP-7702). A plain EOA must send them one by one and stop on any
revert — a deposit is ~8 transactions and is not atomic that way. The owner
pays its own gas (ETH on both chains); sponsorship is only in the web app.
Plans embed slippage bounds and expire — rebuild after ~60s.

## Important

- Chains: Base (id 8453, deposits in USDC) and Robinhood Chain (id 4663,
  deposits in USDG). Gas is ETH on both. Markets are Uniswap v4 pools
  identified by pair slug "<chain>/<base>-<quote>" ("base/eth-usdc",
  "base/cbbtc-eth", "robinhood/tsla-eth"); a bare token means its stablecoin
  pair on Base. Deposits/withdrawals are always in the chain's stablecoin;
  non-stablecoin quotes are converted through the quote's own pool. Every
  plan returns the chainId to execute on.
- kind=stock markets are Robinhood-issued tokens tracking US equities/ETFs on
  Robinhood Chain; availability depends on the party's jurisdiction.
- LP positions carry impermanent-loss risk and can go out of range.

## Human app

Same engine with a consumer UI at https://vaults.cash — Privy login, sponsored gas.
Disclosures: https://vaults.cash/disclosures
